partners.mechanism_chain: MVK (HGNC:7500) —DISRUPTS→ Mevalonate (CHEBI:15343); Mevalonate (CHEBI:15343) —DECREASES→ Mevalonate pathway (WP:WP515); Mevalonate pathway (WP:WP515) —DECREASES→ SREBF1 (HGNC:11100); SREBF1 (HGNC:11100) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal epithelial cell differentiation (HP:0011220); SREBF1 (HGNC:11100) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal mucocutaneous barrier (HP:0030064); Mevalonate pathway (WP:WP515) —LEADS_TO→ Developmental delay (HP:0001263); Mevalonate pathway (WP:WP515) —LEADS_TO→ Failure to thrive (HP:0011344). Loss-of-function mutations in MVK reduce mevalonate production, impairing the mevalonate pathway. This pathway is essential for the synthesis of various isoprenoids, including those that regulate SREBF1 activity.
